newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi shares up in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi shares up in active trade.

text.p: Shares in Hitachi Ltd rose in active trade on Thursday morning on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, due mainly to interest from foreign brokerages and overseas institutional investors, traders said.
By 0122 GMT Hitachi shares were up 60 yen at 1,210 yen, climbing above 1,200 yen for the first time in six years.
Hitachi was the most actively traded issue on the first section of the exchange with turnover of 8.81 million shares.
"Buying interest by foreign brokerages is apparent. Overseas institutional investors are buying actively," an official of a second-tier brokerage said.
An official at a major brokerage said: "Hitachi is being bought as it was falling behind compared with other global blue-chip shares, which have been hitting record highs."
